label: token right after an r, at original steps 3-6
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the step right after the input r, but only at absolute steps 3-6 (strongest at t=4-5, about 0.95 precision there; weaker at t=6; never at t<=2 or t>=7; never in the copy phase). The token at the current step does not matter. When the previous token is r at t=3-6 the feature fires about 86% of the time, and this covers about 83% of activation mass and nearly all of the top quartile. The rest (about 45% of active steps but only about 17% of mass) is weak, diffuse firing at t=3-6 after other tokens (slightly more after f or o), plus a small amount at the delimiter step. It does not fire after r at t<3.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=r (+8.30), t=3 & prev_tok=r (+6.94), prev2_tok=r (+4.67), t=4 (+4.17), t=5 (+3.73), t=4 & prev_tok=r (+3.24). Lower it: t=8 (-6.82), orig_idx=-1 (-6.77), prev3_tok=- (-6.45), t=7 (-6.41).
